name: maxpreps-mcp
description: Look up any US high school on MaxPreps — team schedules, scores, records, rosters, stat leaders and athlete careers

maxpreps_user_agent.title: User-Agent (optional)
maxpreps_user_agent.description: Override the User-Agent sent to MaxPreps. Leave blank to use the built-in one.

maxpreps_cache_ttl.title: Cache TTL in seconds (optional)
maxpreps_cache_ttl.description: How long to reuse a fetched page. Default 300. Set 0 to disable caching.

tools.name: maxpreps_search
tools.description: Find a high school or athlete by name

tools.name: maxpreps_get_school
tools.description: Get a school profile and its identifiers

tools.name: maxpreps_list_teams
tools.description: List every team path a school publishes

tools.name: maxpreps_get_team
tools.description: Get a team season: record, standings, rankings, season list

tools.name: maxpreps_get_schedule
tools.description: Get a team's games with results and scores

tools.name: maxpreps_get_roster
tools.description: Get a team roster with positions and measurements

tools.name: maxpreps_get_rankings
tools.description: Ranked leaderboard of teams for a sport, nationally or by state

tools.name: maxpreps_get_team_rankings
tools.description: Where one team ranks nationally, by state, division and metro

tools.name: maxpreps_get_standings
tools.description: Conference standings table plus ranked stat leaders

tools.name: maxpreps_list_stat_categories
tools.description: List the stat leaderboards available for a sport

tools.name: maxpreps_get_stat_leaderboard
tools.description: Ranked athletes for one stat, statewide or national

tools.name: maxpreps_healthcheck
tools.description: Verify MaxPreps connectivity and build id

tools.name: maxpreps_get_page
tools.description: Return raw page data for any public MaxPreps page
